x-k-k8-07.s.s2.o.c: Subject 이 책 receive action, so form passive, no be causative.

x-k-k8-07.s.s2.r.d: Same form fit be passive or causative; subject and particles decide.
x-k-k8-07.s.s2.explain: Same stem 읽히- fit mean ‘be read’ (passive) or ‘make somebody read’ (causative). Subject 이 책 only fit be read, so passive meaning.
